title: Membership Days in Return-By Courtesy Extensions
content:
Marlowe Rewards membership lengthens a courtesy extension of a Returns & Exchanges return-by date. The core length of the extension follows the customer's Marlowe Rewards membership in status active and how long ago the customer enrolled.

## Membership days

| Customer's Marlowe Rewards membership in status active | Core length of the courtesy extension |
|---|---|
| Platinum, Icon or Atelier, enrolled at least 60 calendar months before today | 21 days |
| Gold, enrolled at least 60 calendar months before today | 14 days |
| Any other customer (any other tier, a shorter enrolment, or no active membership) | The return type's deadline extension days |

## Boundaries

| Membership | Enrolled | Core length |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum, active | Exactly 60 calendar months ago | 21 days |
| Platinum, active | 59 calendar months ago | The return type's deadline extension days |
| Gold, active | 61 calendar months ago | 14 days |
| Silver, active | 90 calendar months ago | The return type's deadline extension days |

The tier, status and enrolment date are read from the Marlowe Rewards membership.
